entities.name: Nicolás Cabrera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolás Cabrera Sánchez (1913–1989), was a Spanish physicist and professor of the Autonomous University of Madrid, who did important work on the theories of crystals and the oxidisation of metals. He is known for the development of the Burton–Cabrera–Frank theory for crystal growth. He spent many years in exile from Spain during the Francoist State.

entities.summary: Nicolás Cabrera Sánchez (1913–1989), was a Spanish physicist and professor of the Autonomous University of Madrid, who did important work on the theories of crystals and the oxidisation of metals. He is known for the development of the Burton–Cabrera–Frank theory for crystal growth. He spent many years in exile from Spain during the Francoist State.
